description: AI videos, images and posts from SwipeForge, published to your social accounts.
useCases: Generate a video, image, post or voice-over from a text prompt.
Track renders and publish to TikTok, Instagram, YouTube or X.
requirements: Sign in with your Nextbrowser account. Generation limits follow your SwipeForge level. Posts go out only after you approve them.
example: Make a 5-second vertical video: a paper boat on a rainy neon street.
